summary:
Earth Trend Detective is a beginner-friendly, no-code project that helps users explore how precipitation changes over time in two contrasting Indian regions: Kerala and Rajasthan. It turns satellite-derived Earth science data into an accessible trend-exploration experience. Users select a region, view a time series, compare annual precipitation, inspect a fitted trend and read an explanation of statistical significance.

The scientific foundation is NASA precipitation data. The team verifies the exact product, version, temporal resolution, units, date coverage and spatial selection before analysis. Monthly data is quality-checked and converted to annual summaries only when the variable is a monthly accumulation. The working tool is built in Google Sheets, so a team with no programming background can create a functional prototype.
details:
Be an Earth Trend System Detective is a project designed to explore and identify changes happening on Earth using satellite data and environmental information. The system analyses Earth observation data to detect environmental trends such as: Climate change and temperature variations. Deforestation and loss of green cover. Changes in water bodies. Air pollution and environmental changes. Natural disasters such as floods and droughts. How it works: Collects Earth observation data from NASA satellite resources. Processes and analyses the collected data. Identifies patterns and changes in the Earth's environment. Displays the results through graphs, maps and visual representations. Helps users understand environmental changes and their possible causes.

Helps people understand environmental changes.

Provides information about climate and environmental trends.

Creates awareness about global warming and deforestation.

Helps identify environmental problems at an early stage.

Makes scientific data easier for students and the public to understand.

Encourages people to take action to protect the Earth.

The main aim of our project is to create awareness about the changing conditions of our planet through NASA Earth observation data.

Our intended impacts are:

To promote environmental awareness among people.

To encourage the responsible use of natural resources.

To help people understand the importance of protecting ecosystems.

To support informed environmental decision-making.

To inspire students and young innovators to contribute to a sustainable future.

Our vision: To make everyone an Earth detective who can observe, understand and help protect our planet.

Category Tools / Technologies

Programming language Python, JavaScript

Frontend HTML, CSS

Data sources NASA Earthdata, NASA Earth Observation

Data visualisation Matplotlib, Chart.js

Development tools Visual Studio Code

Mapping Leaflet / Google Maps

Hardware Laptop, computer, internet connection

NASA resources:

NASA Earthdata⁠

NASA Earth Observatory⁠

NASA POWER Data⁠Your oject is creative because it transforms complex scientific and satellite data into simple, understandable information.

It gives users the experience of becoming Earth detectives.

It combines science, technology and environmental awareness.

It uses visual representations to explain environmental changes.

It makes learning about our planet more interactive and interesting.

It encourages users to explore environmental problems rather than simply reading about them.

The unique idea is to make environmental monitoring feel like solving a mystery, where users investigate clues and discover changes happening on Earth. considered the following factors: Accuracy: Using reliable NASA satellite and environmental data. User-friendliness: Making the system simple and easy to use. Environmental importance: Focusing on major environmental challenges. Accessibility: Making information understandable to different types of users. Creativity: Presenting data in an interesting and interactive way. Reliability: Ensuring that the information displayed is meaningful and trustworthy. Sustainability: Encouraging long-term environmental protection. Feasibility: Choosing technologies and features that can realistically be developed.
